title: October 15 Update
summary: Starting point of this archive: the state of every hero and item as compiled on Oct 26–27, 2026, after the October 15 update. Only part of this patch's notes was available, so the list below is partial.

general: Nurse Harrow and Violet join the roster.
heroes: Baba's Brew cooldown 27s (was 25s); barrier 90 (was 100), scaling 0.7 (was 1.2); T2 −14s cooldown (was −12s).
Strix Salvo cooldown 25s (was 30s); T2 +30 damage and +45 marked damage.
Chimera Mk1 self-damage 10% max health (was 12%); T3 overheat refund 50% (was 40%).
Close The Deal bonus damage 75% (was 50%); T1 +90 damage (was +50).

heroes.name: Abrams
heroes.summary: A close-range bruiser detective who wades into fights, drains nearby enemies with a cursed tome, and shrugs off damage. Charges or leaps into teams to isolate and stun fragile targets.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.desc: Drains health from nearby enemies over time, dealing spirit damage and healing Abrams for part of it. He keeps full mobility while it runs.

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.desc: Charges forward dragging enemies he hits. Slamming a hero into a wall stuns them; hitting a hero speeds up the charge.
up: −18s cooldown; hero hit grants +1.5 weapon damage for 6s

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.desc: Grants bonus defensive stats. A portion of damage taken is stored and regenerated back over time.

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.desc: Leaps high and slams down, dealing spirit damage and stunning enemies in the impact area. Can drag airborne enemies down with him.
up: Unstoppable for 5s on cast, +6m impact radius

weapon.name: Case Closed
traits: Shotgun: 9 pellets in a square pattern with a center pellet
Reloads one shell at a time and can be interrupted

heroes.name: Apollo
heroes.summary: A fast fencer, a young prince of Ixia, who picks off isolated enemies with precise strikes.

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.desc: Creates a sigil sphere ahead, then leaps backward as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
up: Bonus fire rate and bullet speed for 8s
Hitting a player restores stamina and resets air jump/dash

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.desc: Readies a parry against the next attack. A successful deflect grants brief invulnerability and dashes Apollo to an enemy hero, stunning them and lowering their melee resist.
up: Longer pommel stun, more melee resist reduction

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.desc: Lunges in a direction delivering piercing stabs; releasing in the perfect timing window deals maximum damage. Can be recast.
up: Perfect hit on a hero heals Apollo
Lower cooldown, bullet resist during lunge
More perfect-hit damage, faster and longer lunge

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.desc: A long-range slash that freezes struck enemies in slow motion, halting their actions and healing. When it ends they take heavy damage, more below half health. Apollo is invulnerable during it.
up: More bonus damage vs. half-health enemies

weapon.name: Pride of Ixia
traits: Projectile with a hard 25m range: no falloff inside it, no damage beyond it

heroes.name: Baba
heroes.summary: A hexing grandmother who fights from a long-legged bench, throwing brews, yarn and bread to drain spirit and turn enemies into pigeons.

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.desc: Throws a tangled thread that follows her aim, then bursts for spirit damage and steals enemy Spirit. While holding stolen Spirit her bullets deal bonus spirit damage.

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.desc: Extends the bench's legs to boost move speed, jump height, and debuff/melee resist. Her kick and ground pound knock enemies back or up; the pound also slows and deals spirit damage.

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.desc: Throws a pot of tea creating a zone that cycles between a barrier, a silence, and a scalding burn that shreds spirit resist. She can pause or resume the cycle while holding it.

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.desc: Channels to place bread on targets in front of her, slowing them. Pigeons then swarm marked targets, dealing spirit damage and turning them into pigeons — more bread means more damage and duration.

innates.name: Bullet vulnerability
innates.desc: Takes 7% more base bullet damage.

weapon.name: Bunko-Night Special
traits: Damage per target is the same however many pellets hit

heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.summary: A scrap golem whose extendable arm yanks enemies out of position, finishing them with sticky bombs and a channeled beam.

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.desc: Launches nearby enemies into the air with melee damage; anyone still grounded when it lands takes spirit damage and a fire-rate slow. Can be cast on allies.
up: Hero hit: faster spin-up, 2× weapon range, +30% weapon damage for 9s
Hero hit: resets Grapple Arm, restores 18% missing health

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.desc: Attaches a bomb to a nearby target that explodes after a fuse for area spirit damage. Bombs that hit heroes permanently stack bonus damage.
up: On cast: +5 m/s move speed, +25% debuff resist for 6s

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.desc: Fires a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits to Bebop. Works on allies too, with a brief slow on arrival for enemies.
up: +20% weapon damage vs. pulled target for 6s

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.desc: Channels a long beam that deals damage over time and slows enemies. Bebop hovers while channeling and heals from damage dealt.
up: Heals 65% of hero damage, 20% of non-hero

weapon.name: Humble Pie
traits: Beam weapon with no bullet travel time
Max range 32m (+2m per boon); no damage past it
Short wind-up before firing; zooming also winds it up

heroes.name: Billy
heroes.summary: A reckless front-line brawler who closes distance with charges and ground slams, then chains whole groups together.

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.desc: Leaps up then slams his bat down, pulling nearby enemies in for melee and spirit damage and knocking them up. Hold to rise higher and delay the slam.
up: −3s charge time, adds 50% of heavy melee damage

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.desc: Charges headfirst at an enemy hero, launching both of them into the air. Cooldown halves on impact.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.desc: Passively, melee hits restore ammo and briefly mark enemies as Wrecked. Activated, his bullets deal bonus damage to Wrecked enemies and melee hits grant bonus max health and extend the buff.
up: +1 Bashdown charge, +7% bullet damage vs. Wrecked

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.desc: Tethers nearby enemy heroes, then after a delay yanks them all toward Billy, slowing and dealing spirit damage. Tethers break without line of sight.
up: +5m range; each pulled hero grants 1.3s Unstoppable

innates.name: Fast light melee
innates.desc: Light melee recovers faster, slows him less and doesn't interrupt reloading.

innates.name: Melee ammo restore
innates.desc: Once Blasted is unlocked, heavy melee refills 100% of his ammo and light melee refills 35%.

weapon.name: Biquette
traits: Projectile with an octagon recoil pattern; first shot hits the crosshair

heroes.name: Calico
heroes.summary: A stealthy former monster hunter who prowls as her cat Ava and ambushes with bombs and a leaping slash.

abilities.name: Gloom Bombs
abilities.desc: Throws a cluster of bombs that explode after a short delay for spirit damage; extra hits on the same target deal reduced damage.
up: Each bomb applies −6% melee resist for 6s

abilities.name: Leaping Slash
abilities.desc: Dashes forward and slashes all enemies around her for melee damage, healing a bit if she hits a hero.

abilities.name: Ava
abilities.desc: Transforms into her cat Ava for ramping move speed and minimap invisibility. Taking hero damage resets the speed bonus.
up: Ramping damage amp up to 18%, lingers 6s

abilities.name: Return to Shadows
abilities.desc: After a short channel becomes untargetable in shadow with bonus speed, dealing spirit damage, then reappears and deals spirit damage again.
up: On completion heals 450 and refreshes other cooldowns

weapon.name: Sweetest Lie
traits: Shotgun: 9 pellets in a diamond pattern

heroes.name: Celeste
heroes.summary: A Coney Island sideshow star who floats above fights hurling light — and hides that she's secretly a unicorn.

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.desc: Blasts a cone of light that marks enemies with spirit damage over time; Celeste gains spirit lifesteal from them, and melee detonates the stored bonus damage.

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.desc: Wraps her in a prism barrier that explodes when broken, dealing damage based on the barrier and silencing nearby enemies.
up: +1.25s silence, −20s cooldown, lets Shining Wonder bounce

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.desc: Calls a beam of light onto an area that explodes after a delay; each hero hit grants a stacking spirit buff.
up: +9% fire rate and +4% spirit amp per stack

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.desc: Charges and releases a light orb that damages and slows, then bounces between nearby enemies, prioritizing heroes.
up: Stronger slow on targets (−16% move, −14% dash)

innates.name: Floaty
innates.desc: 25% lower gravity, 44% more air control and 10% more air acceleration, so she glides and steers mid-air.

weapon.name: Carny Life
traits: Arcing projectile that bounces off the first surface it hits
Homes toward enemies within about 45° of its path, and toward soul orbs
Direct hits can ricochet to a second nearly aligned enemy, and ricochets can headshot

heroes.name: Deadman Danny
heroes.summary: An aerial maniac with a rocket launcher and jetpack who marks enemies with missiles and grabs a victim for a crash landing.

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.desc: Fires a line of spirit missiles that lodge in the ground and explode on a delay or proximity, marking enemies. A charged shot on a marked enemy consumes it for bonus damage and a slow.

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.desc: Hold to fly on a jetpack that builds heat. At max heat he dives and explodes on impact, launching enemies — and stunning himself if no hero is hit.
up: Heat dissipates faster on the ground
Heals on hero hit, no self-damage

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.desc: Sprays fuel that burns and shreds bullet resist, ending in a backblast that damages and knocks Danny backward while venting jetpack heat.
up: +60 burst damage; backblast hit gives +18% fire rate
+10% resist shred; backblast applies a mark

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.desc: Dashes to an enemy, grabs them, and flies upward before crashing down; both take spirit damage, extra against targets below half health.

innates.name: Rocket jumping
innates.desc: Charged shots that only hit terrain knock him back like a rocket jump and cost 5% max HP, with no self-damage if they hit a hero.

innates.name: No headshots
innates.desc: Neither fire mode can headshot, so headshot items and Ricochet do nothing for him.

weapon.name: Chimera Peace Bringer
traits: Hold fire to charge a rocket; it fires automatically at max charge
Charged shot costs 2 ammo and explodes in a 2.5m radius
Charged shots build debuff items 3× faster

heroes.name: The Doorman
heroes.summary: A polite, quietly godlike bellhop who opens portals across the map and checks enemies into a pocket-dimension hotel.

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.desc: Throws a bell that damages on impact then detonates, reducing accuracy and slowing. Can be shot to trigger early.
up: Bigger radius, longer lifetime, better scaling

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.desc: Places two linked doors; players and most projectiles entering one exit the other until they close.
up: More range and door distance; scales with spirit

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.desc: Sends a cart that damages and drags enemy heroes along its path. Can be cast on allies instead.
up: More range; bonus damage on wall hit
Lower cooldown; wall hit stuns dragged targets

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.desc: After a channel, sends a target to the Baroness Hotel. They must check out in time or take extra damage, then return to where they were.
up: More damage; stun on failed checkout
Target unstoppable in hotel; shorter cooldown on failed checkout

weapon.name: Service With A Smile
traits: Slow projectile (203 m/s) that pierces; 50% less damage after the first target
With Split Shot stacks, pierced shots deal full damage to every target

heroes.name: Drifter
heroes.summary: An ancient vampire who hunts isolated heroes by bloodscent, marks them to bleed, and teleports behind them.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Swipes a cone in front for spirit damage; enemies at close range take bonus melee damage.
up: Heavy melee-scaled damage and 2s silence at close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.desc: Fires a mark that makes the first target hit bleed. Recast while they bleed to teleport behind them.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.desc: Isolated enemy heroes leave a trail and can be sensed from afar. Drifter deals bonus damage to them; kills/assists on them grant permanent weapon damage.
up: +3 m/s move speed near isolated enemies
Isolated kill heals 24% missing health, restores 2 stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.desc: Plunges nearby enemy heroes into darkness, cutting their vision and briefly revealing them. They count as isolated and Drifter gains sprint speed.

weapon.name: Crimson Grasp
traits: Shotgun: 3 pellets per shot in alternating diagonal volleys that form an X
Very short range: falloff 22–27m, no damage past max range

heroes.name: Dynamo
heroes.summary: A supportive scientist whose body was destroyed by an Astral Gate; heals and teleports allies, and drops a team-wiping singularity.

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.desc: Sends an energy pulse along the ground that deals spirit damage and knocks enemies into the air.
up: On hit: −15% bullet resist, −24% move speed for 4s

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.desc: Briefly becomes untargetable while teleporting to a spot and restores stamina. Alt-cast brings nearby allies along.
up: Halves non-ultimate debuff duration, refunds a charge

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.desc: Channels a healing aura for himself and nearby allies; dashing and melee don't interrupt it.
up: Full movement/abilities while channeling, +2.5% max HP heal/s

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.desc: Creates a singularity that stuns, pulls nearby enemies inward, and deals spirit damage over time.
up: Adds 6% of max health as damage

heroes.name: Graves
heroes.summary: A necromancer who raises ghouls and Deadheads, opens spirit rifts, and steals her victims' power.

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.desc: Collects death from nearby kills, then throws a jar releasing Deadheads that repeatedly hit enemies. With no enemies nearby they follow Graves and focus her target.

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.desc: Tears a line in the ground that raises a ghoul and leaves a rift; enemies crossing it take damage and are immobilized.

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.desc: Her weapon gradually steals enemies' weapon damage and spirit resist, up to a cap per target and a limited number of targets.
up: +1 target; all summons apply Essence Theft

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
abilities.desc: Places a gravestone that keeps summoning ghouls (breakable with heavy melee). Her abilities also send ghouls marching toward the enemy base.

weapon.name: The Teacher
traits: Beam that locks onto the target nearest your reticle; no headshots
Every 13th consecutive shot deals double damage; the count resets on reload or target switch
No damage falloff, but buildup weakens past 7.6–17m
Air-dashing while firing pauses ammo use

heroes.name: Grey Talon
heroes.summary: A veteran monster hunter with a magazine-fed bow, traps, short flights, and a spirit owl that finishes weakened targets.

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.desc: Hold to charge a piercing arrow for heavy spirit damage; charging lowers your gravity and walk speed.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.desc: Launches into the air for a glide with boosted weapon damage and multishot; landing ends it.

abilities.name: Spirit Snare
abilities.desc: Places a trap that arms then curses and slows enemies who enter. A charged shot can detonate it early for a bigger area.

abilities.name: Guided Owl
abilities.desc: Launches a spirit owl you steer manually; it explodes to damage and stun, granting permanent Spirit Power per hero killed.

heroes.name: Haze
heroes.summary: A stealth assassin who picks off isolated targets with smoke, sleep daggers, and twin SMGs.

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.desc: Throws a dagger that damages and puts the target to sleep (damage wakes them shortly after). Doesn't break invisibility.
up: Bullet resist reduction for 6s after waking
−17s cooldown; slows movement and dash after waking

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.desc: Turns invisible with a sprint boost. Shooting breaks it, items don't; nearby enemies can still see her.
up: Purges non-ultimate debuffs, +50% bullet lifesteal for 5s

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.desc: Each bullet on a target stacks bonus damage against that target; headshots add extra stacks.
up: Every 20 stacks: bonus spirit damage and 2s slow

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.desc: Enters a frenzy, firing at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and bonus damage while gaining evasion. Can still move and use items.

weapon.name: Censure & Penance
traits: Magazine grows with Spirit Power (25 + 0.5 per Spirit Power)

heroes.name: Holliday
heroes.summary: A former small-town sheriff and revolver marksman who sets up fights with powder kegs, bounce pads, and a spirit lasso.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.desc: Throws a barrel that explodes after a delay, burning and knocking up enemies. Shots, melee, or other barrels can detonate it early.

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.desc: Drops a pad that launches heroes into the air; landing creates a damaging stomp. Allies get air control.
up: Allies get a move speed burst on landing

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.desc: While off cooldown, her next headshot deals bonus damage and slows. Ignores range falloff; NPC hits shorten the cooldown.

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.desc: Throws a lasso that damages, pulls the target to Holliday, and stuns them. Using a Bounce Pad extends the stun.

heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.summary: An Ixian fire-wielder turned bartender who sets everything alight and blows up mid-fight.

abilities.name: Napalm
abilities.desc: Sprays a flammable mix that damages, slows, and coats targets so they take more damage and heal less.

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.desc: Dashes forward with slow resist, leaving a burning trail. Hold forward to extend.

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.desc: Weapon hits build a burn that deals spirit damage over time; each hit refreshes and extends it.

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.desc: Becomes a living bomb that explodes after a short, uninterruptible delay, damaging and stunning everyone nearby.

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.summary: A dependable gargoyle who tethers to and air-drops allies, turns to stone, and chokes enemies with thorns.

abilities.name: Entangling Thorns
abilities.desc: Places a patch of thorns that damages and slows enemies inside.

abilities.name: Kudzu Connection
abilities.desc: Tethers to an ally, sharing bonuses and healing and removing shooting move penalties.

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.desc: Becomes invulnerable stone and slams down, damaging and stunning nearby enemies while healing herself.

abilities.name: Air Drop
abilities.desc: Carries an ally into flight then drops them as an explosive bomb; both gain damage afterward. 30% shorter cooldown on allies.

innates.name: Light flier
innates.desc: 10% lower gravity while airborne, so she falls more slowly.

heroes.name: Kelvin
heroes.summary: An undead ice scientist who slows enemies, builds ice highways, and shelters allies in a frozen dome.

abilities.name: Frost Grenade
abilities.desc: Throws a grenade that bursts into a freezing cloud, healing allies and damaging and slowing enemies. 2 charges.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.desc: Creates a floating trail of ice that speeds up Kelvin and allies (enemies can use it too) and gives him slow resist.

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.desc: Channels a freezing beam that ramps up a move and fire-rate slow the longer it holds. Can secure souls.

abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
abilities.desc: Encases Kelvin or a chosen hero in an impenetrable ice dome; allies inside regenerate fast, enemies inside are slowed.

weapon.name: Expedition's End
traits: Heavy-hitting automatic, slow projectile at 160 m/s

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.summary: A spirit-bound femme fatale who spends her own health to fuel attacks, then drains enemies to refill it.

abilities.name: Essence Bomb
abilities.desc: Spends some of her health to lob a bomb that arms briefly then explodes, leaving a damaging toxic patch.
up: Patch deals 30% of bomb damage per second for 6s

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.desc: Tethers an enemy, continuously damaging them and healing Geist, even through broken line of sight. Alt-cast transfers health to an ally.

abilities.name: Malice
abilities.desc: Spends health to fire blood shards that apply stacking Malice — each stack slows and makes the target take more damage from Geist.

abilities.name: Soul Exchange
abilities.desc: Swaps health percentages with a nearby enemy hero (within minimum thresholds) to flip a fight.
up: +60 spirit, +40% fire rate, +50% spirit resist for 8s

innates.name: Non-lethal self-damage
innates.desc: The health she spends on Essence Bomb, Malice and Life Drain's alt cast can't kill her, and spirit resist reduces it.

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.summary: The Bear Pit champion — a whip-cracking brawler who grapples through the air and slams whole teams into the ground.

abilities.name: Ground Strike
abilities.desc: Stomps a forward wedge; cast mid-air to dive down, gaining damage the farther he falls.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.desc: Pulls Lash through the air toward a target and resets his air jumps and dashes.
up: +1 charge; +1 stamina and +60% air control on cast

abilities.name: Flog
abilities.desc: Whips enemies in front, healing Lash for part of the damage (less from non-heroes).

abilities.name: Death Slam
abilities.desc: Latches whips onto enemies in view, lifts and stuns them, then slams them down to damage and slow the landing zone.

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.summary: A mechanic who controls the field with turrets, spectral walls, a healing specter, and a rocket barrage.

abilities.name: Mini Turret
abilities.desc: Deploys a turret that automatically shoots nearby enemies until it expires (reduced vs. troopers and objectives).

abilities.name: Medicinal Specter
abilities.desc: Summons a spirit that heals nearby allies over its duration.
up: +2% max HP regen, +3m radius, +40% spirit resist

abilities.name: Spectral Wall
abilities.desc: Sends out a wall that slows enemies passing through; detonate early to damage and split the area.

abilities.name: Heavy Barrage
abilities.desc: Fires a volley of homing rockets onto a target area over time; she's slowed while firing.

innates.name: Weapon spin-up
innates.desc: Her gun spins up over 2 seconds from 4.76 to 11.9 shots/s, widening its spread, and winds down 25% per second when she stops.

innates.name: Spirit resist scaling
innates.desc: Starts with 0% spirit resist and gains 0.35% per boon.

weapon.name: Services Rendered
traits: Automatic minigun: 2s spin-up to max fire rate, spread widens as it spins
Up to 11.9 shots/s at full spin, falloff 20–58m

heroes.name: Mina
heroes.summary: A fragile, slippery vampire who harasses with spirit bullets and bat forms, building toward a swarm of silencing bats.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.desc: Slashes with her umbrella for spirit damage that grows with the target's missing health, healing per kill. Hold alt-fire to float briefly; executes low-health non-heroes.

abilities.name: Sanguine Retreat
abilities.desc: Bursts into bats and flies untargetable to a chosen spot; can be recast briefly.
up: +25% fire rate and 8 bonus bullets for 8s

abilities.name: Love Bites
abilities.desc: Bullets deal bonus spirit damage and her abilities build toward a bonus bite on a target (10s per-target cooldown).

abilities.name: Nox Nostra
abilities.desc: Releases a cloud of homing bats that each damage and silence. Every Love Bites proc on a hero permanently adds bats.

innates.name: Debuff vulnerability
innates.desc: −8% debuff resist, so debuffs on her last slightly longer.

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.summary: A wind-and-sand Djinn bodyguard who marks targets, whirls through fights as a dust devil, and teleports anywhere on the map.

abilities.name: Fire Scarabs
abilities.desc: Sends scarabs to infest an enemy, draining health over time and reducing their damage output.

abilities.name: Dust Devil
abilities.desc: Becomes a moving whirlwind that damages, slows, and lifts enemies, emerging with bullet evasion. Invincible while casting.

abilities.name: Djinn's Mark
abilities.desc: Shots apply marks; when they expire or are consumed they deal spirit damage and briefly reveal the target. Each extra mark doubles the damage.
up: More base damage, longer multiplier window
Lower cooldown, +1 max mark, stun at max marks

abilities.name: Traveler
abilities.desc: After a channel, teleports to any spot on the minimap. Damage interrupts the channel.
up: Move speed and fire rate for 12s on arrival

heroes.name: Mo & Krill
heroes.summary: A two-headed bruiser duo who tunnel under the battlefield, sandblast enemies, and lock a single target down.

abilities.name: Scorn
abilities.desc: Damages nearby enemies through walls and floors, healing for part of it (more vs. heroes).

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.desc: Burrows underground with speed and resists, then erupts to damage, slow, and knock up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.desc: Fires a fast sand projectile that damages and disarms enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Combo
abilities.desc: Holds a target in place, stunning and damaging over the channel. A kill during or just after permanently grants max health.

innates.name: Two heads
innates.desc: Both heads can be headshot, but Mo's head takes 20% less headshot damage.

innates.name: Tunnel access
innates.desc: Crouch next to a vent, or while burrowed, to enter or exit tunnels, but not while in combat.

weapon.name: Yellow Canary
traits: Rapid-fire spread: 4 pellets in a triangle plus 1 center pellet

heroes.name: Nurse Harrow
heroes.summary: A harsh possession-ward nurse who drains enemies with leeches and heals allies with syringe shots.

abilities.name: Leech Therapy
abilities.desc: Throws a jar of leeches that latch on, dealing damage and draining enemy buffs. Collect them to heal, gain regen and fire rate, and build leech stacks.
up: Bigger radius, better scaling, +8 max stacks

abilities.name: Wretched Vapors
abilities.desc: Puts a vapor on herself or an ally for a speed rush that converts incoming damage into delayed specters, which detonate as a slowing crash.

abilities.name: Healing Needles
abilities.desc: Loads her weapon with syringes that heal allies on hit; charges come from dealing damage and collected leeches.
up: More heal per shot, restores stamina

abilities.name: Lurking Terrors
abilities.desc: Opens her bag to unleash horrors in front of her; enemies who look at her build fear until they flee. Leeches extend the fear.
up: Slows feared enemies, adds damage over time
Longer channel, damage immunity while channeling

heroes.name: Paige
heroes.summary: A bibliomancer searching for her missing brother; her books summon dragons, shield allies, and send a cavalry charge across the city.

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.desc: Throws a book that summons a dragon which flies forward leaving a burning trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.desc: Gives an ally a barrier that also boosts their weapon damage while it lasts.
up: Hits up to 2 more allies, better scaling

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.desc: Creates a slowing area that detonates after a delay to damage and immobilize enemies.

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.desc: Sends spectral knights riding across the whole city, healing allies and damaging enemies — stronger the farther they travel.

weapon.name: Chapter's End
traits: No headshot crits, but headshot items still trigger
Mystic Shot only procs on the first target; Split Shot stacks from multi-hits

heroes.name: Paradox
heroes.summary: A time-bender who freezes projectiles, stops enemies in time, and swaps places with them to drag them into her team.

abilities.name: Pulse Grenade
abilities.desc: Throws a grenade that pulses, damaging and slowing enemies while stacking a damage amp for Paradox.

abilities.name: Time Wall
abilities.desc: Creates a wall that freezes enemy projectiles and boosts allied bullets passing through; enemies crossing are slowed.

abilities.name: Kinetic Carbine
abilities.desc: Charges a shot that deals weapon-scaled spirit damage and time-stops the target. Full charge grants move speed.

abilities.name: Paradoxical Swap
abilities.desc: Fires a projectile that swaps places with the first enemy hero hit, then damages them and grants Paradox a barrier.
up: Swaps all enemies within 7m, +10% max HP damage

heroes.name: Pocket
heroes.summary: A close-range trickster with a spread shotgun who teleports via a flying cloak and hides inside a briefcase.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.desc: Channels a volley of spirit projectiles that damage and slow where they land; each hero hit stacks a damage amp for Pocket.

abilities.name: Flying Cloak
abilities.desc: Sends out a sentient cloak that damages along its path; recast to teleport to it.
